about_the_game:
The original soundtrack to Earl vs. the Mutants, composed and performed by Dark Twin Production and Tommy McKay. This soundtrack includes 13 tracks with over 74 minutes of metal bliss. Provided in mp3 format and an optional FLAC download for our audiophile fans.

Original Soundtrack includes:
-8 songs composed and performed by Dark Twin Production
-5 songs composed and performed by Tommy McKay
